lines.en: Excuse me. Which train line goes to downtown?
Take the red line.
How often does the train come?
Every ten minutes during normal hours.
Where can I buy a subway ticket?
You can buy tickets at the vending machine over there.
How much is a one-way fare?
Three dollars one way.
Is this incoming train express or local?
It's a local. It stops at every station.
Do I need to transfer lines?
No transfer needed. But could I remind you, which stop will you get off at?
I'm not sure. Which stop should I get off at for the city square?
Get off at City Center Station. Don't miss your stop.
Thank you very much for your help!
You're welcome. Have a nice trip.
The contractor's construction work is almost finished. What full-site closing safety tasks do we need to arrange first?

First, the contractor leads full-site self-inspection. They need to restore site housekeeping, dismantle temporary safety facilities, and walk through the whole area to identify and eliminate potential hazards like leftover flammable materials.
After project handover, how do we assess this contractor's safety performance?
We use the unified evaluation form. Key items cover site housekeeping, PPE compliance, fall protection, chemical management, daily toolbox talks and permit execution, plus injury incident records.
Is the safety score included in their overall quarterly business review rating?
Absolutely. EHS accounts for 20% of the total QBR score. Top-rated contractors get priority for new bids, while poor performers will face bidding limits or removal from our contractor list.
Will the final QBR score influence the contractor's service fees?
Absolutely. If points are deducted for the 20% EHS section, we will deduct the service fee in the corresponding proportion.
